title: Accordion
description: Lets you show and hide content, on its own or as a group.

title: Anchor
description: Places floating content next to an element with CSS anchor positioning.

title: Avatar
description: Avatars show a person or entity as an image, initials or icon.

title: Badge
description: Badges attach a small count or status dot to another element.

title: Button group
description: Groups related buttons.

title: Button
description: Buttons allow users to take actions with a single tap.

title: Callout
description: Callouts call out for user attention. Should be part of the flow and used without interrupting the user's task.
keywords: alert banner message box notice warning

title: Card
description: A surface for related content and actions, on its own or as the base of accordions, dialogs and more.

title: Carousel
description: A scrolling list with snap points, buttons and markers.

title: Checkbox
description: Use a Checkbox for choices that are submitted with a form. For a setting that applies right away, use a Switch, and for options in a toolbar a Toggle. See also: Checkbox field group.

title: Chip
description: Chips are compact elements that represent an input, attribute, or action. Use them for filters, tags and choices. For the main action, like Save or Send, use a Button.

title: Copy
description: A button that copies text or a field's value to the clipboard.

title: Description list
description: Description lists are used to display a list of terms and their descriptions.

title: Dialog
description: A minimally styled window overlaid on the main content. By design the Dialog is minimal with zero content to allow for both modal and non-modal use.

title: Divider
description: It's just a line.

title: Drawer
description: Slides in from the sides, top or bottom of the screen. Good for navigation, filters and side content. For a question or a short task that needs the user's full attention, use a Dialog.

title: Form
description: Spacing and grouping for form fields.

title: Layout
description: Six classes for the space between components: .ui-layout-column, .ui-layout-row, .ui-layout-grid, .ui-layout-columns, .ui-layout-media and .ui-layout-container. Put them on wrapper elements, such as div, section or ul. They sit in the utils layer, so on a component they replace its own layout. Their gaps come from the --ui-space-* scale, so they follow --ui-space-scale.

title: List
description: Lists are continuous, vertical indexes of text and images and video. Use lists to help users find a specific item and act on it.

title: Menu
description: A popover list of actions or links.

title: Message
description: Chat bubbles that group by sender, with attachments, reactions and a typing indicator.

title: Number field
description: A number field with buttons that step the value down and up, for amounts like a quantity.

title: One-time code
description: A one-time password (OTP) field: one input drawn as a box per character, with paste and SMS autofill.

title: Progress
description: See also: Spinner.

title: Radio
description: See also: Form documentation.

title: Range
description: Range lets users pick a number by sliding a thumb along a track.

title: Rating
description: A star rating: a meter that shows a score, or radios that collect one.

title: Select
description: Leverages the List component to provide markup for the Select popover. Use a Select to pick a value in a form. For actions, use a Menu.

title: Spinner
description: Add it to an element with aria-busy="true". Spinners are always indeterminate. See also: Progress bar.

title: 1. Because it's blocked by another use case
Stat
description: A stat shows one number with its label and the change behind it.

title: Stepper
description: Shows where someone is in a flow of steps, such as a checkout.

title: Switch
description: Use a Switch for a setting that applies right away. Use a Checkbox for choices that are submitted with a form, and a Toggle for options in a toolbar. See also: Switch field group.

title: Table
description: Displays tabular data. Basic tables with row and column headers, and optional captions and footers.

title: Tabs
description: The Tabs are radio inputs and the Panels are just divs that show and hide based on the radio inputs' :checked state. Use Tabs to switch between panels of content. To pick an option, like a list or grid view, use a Toggle group.

title: Text field
description: An input for single-line text data. Basic text fields with labels, field descriptions, and validation states.
keywords: email input password search text box

title: Textarea
description: An input for multi-line text data. Basic textareas with labels, supporting text, and validation states.

title: Timeline
description: A list of dated events with markers and a connecting line.

title: Toast
description: Short messages that confirm an action and dismiss themselves.

title: Toggle
description: Toggle buttons and toggle groups switch options on and off, alone or as a set.

title: Tooltip
description: A short label or hint for a control, shown on hover, focus or a long press.

title: Typography
description: Styles for headings, body text, and other text content. Use util classes anywhere or wrap content in .ui-rich-text.

title: Accessibility
description: A few basics to get you started. OPUI leans on native HTML, so a lot comes for free, but you still decide the names, the order and the content. Test with a keyboard and a screen reader, it always depends.

title: Acknowledgments
description: Open Props UI stands on a lot of shoulders. These are the people, projects and resources that made it possible.

title: Browser support
description: The web platform features the components rely on, and the browsers that ship each one.

title: Concepts
description: The architecture: cascade layers, token tiers, scopes, props and classes, naming, rich text, and where JavaScript is still needed.

title: Customizing
description: Where your CSS goes: a theme in theme.custom changes the whole library, a component's --_* properties change one component or one instance, and your own layer holds the rest.

title: Migrating from v5 to v6
description: The breaking changes in v6 and how to update your code, component by component.

title: Theme tokens
description: Every token theme.css and core/palette.css declare, with its default and its tier, and the instance inputs components read. The largest group is roles; the others are marked knob, primitive, hook, component or input. The tests check every promised contrast ratio in light and dark mode, with and without more contrast.

title: Theming
description: The knobs and roles behind colors, density, spacing, corners, fonts, elevation, motion and contrast, and the classes that scope them.

title: Why Open Props UI?
description: Components built from the HTML and CSS the platform ships today, as files you can read, copy and own.

title: Getting started
description: OPUI ships Solid 2 components, in preview while Solid 2 is a release candidate. Install the package, import what you need, and you're set.

title: An accordion that animates to auto
description: interpolate-size and ::details-content let a details element transition to its natural height.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback interpolate-size JavaScript that measures the content and animates a pixel height. `interpolate-size: allow-keywords` and `::details-content` transition a `<details>` to its natural height. details-content interpolate-size

title: Hover cards without JavaScript
description: interestfor, popover=hint and anchor positioning open a hover card on hover and focus.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback interestfor Timers for hover intent, focus and blur listeners, and a positioning library that measures and flips the card. `interestfor` and `popover="hint"` open it on hover and focus, and anchor positioning places it. anchor-positioning interest-invokers popover-hint

title: Squircle avatars with corner-shape
description: aspect-ratio, :has(img) and corner-shape for avatars.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback corner-shape An SVG mask or a `clip-path` path: a fixed shape that clips borders and shadows too. `corner-shape: squircle` draws the corner, and `aspect-ratio: 1` keeps the avatar square. aspect-ratio corner-shape has

title: One Button, no IconButton
description: :has(> svg:only-child) turns any Button into an icon button.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback Gotchas :has() A separate `IconButton` component or an `iconOnly` prop, with every size and variant built twice. `:has(> svg:only-child)` lets the button see that it only holds an icon. has

title: Severity colors from one source color
description: Relative colors and light-dark() derive every severity shade from one color.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback oklch(from …) 40 hand-picked colors for five severities in two schemes, or a preprocessor that only works at build time. One `--ui-palette-source` per severity, and `oklch(from …)` derives every shade. light-dark relative-color

title: A carousel made of CSS
description: Scroll snap, ::scroll-button() and ::scroll-marker: a carousel without JavaScript.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback ::scroll-button() JavaScript that listens to scroll events to run the buttons and dots, with their accessibility done by hand. `::scroll-button()` and `::scroll-marker` generate focusable buttons and dots. scroll-buttons scroll-markers scroll-snap

title: Drawing a checkbox
description: appearance: none, a clip-path checkmark and system colors for a native checkbox.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback appearance: none A hidden input and a fake box with an SVG check that mirrors every state. `appearance: none` lets the real input draw its own box and check. appearance clip-path

title: Leader lines with grid
description: A container query and a grid pseudo-element draw dotted leader lines.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback @container A row of clipped dots, a repeating background or an empty filler element, and a media query that only knows the viewport. A grid per pair with a dotted `::after` between term and description, and a container query for the column. container-queries

title: Dialogs without JavaScript
description: Invoker commands, closedby and @starting-style for modal dialogs.
headings: The problem The trick Keyboard shortcuts Try it Scroll lock Fallback closedby A click handler for `showModal()`, another for `close()`, and a backdrop listener that checks where the click landed. `commandfor`, `command` and `closedby` open and close it, `@starting-style` fades it in, and `allow-discrete` fades it out. dialog-closedby invoker-commands overlay starting-style transition-behavior

title: Sliding drawers with @starting-style
description: A dialog that slides in from any edge, and out again with allow-discrete.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback @starting-style A fixed `<div>` with JavaScript for the focus trap, Esc and backdrop clicks, and a class removed after `transitionend` to animate it out. A modal `<dialog>` that slides with `translate`, `@starting-style` and `allow-discrete`. display-animation overlay starting-style transition-behavior

title: Fluid type with progress()
description: progress() turns the viewport width into one 0 to 1 ramp that the four fluid heading sizes share.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback progress() A clamp() per heading with a hand-tuned vi slope, so every heading grew over a different range of viewport widths. `progress(100vi, start, end)` is one shared ramp, and each fluid heading mixes its two steps with it. progress-function

title: Smarter fieldsets with :has()
description: :has() lets fieldsets and legends style themselves from what they contain.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback :has(:required) Modifier classes or props kept in sync with what the fieldset contains. `:has()` lets the fieldset and legend style themselves from their content. has

title: Menus with popover and anchor positioning
description: Popover, invoker commands and anchor positioning: a menu with no JavaScript.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback popover JavaScript to toggle and dismiss it, `z-index` fights, and a positioning library that measures and flips. `popover`, invoker commands and anchor positioning, with the trigger as the implicit anchor. anchor-positioning invoker-commands popover

title: Styling the native progress bar
description: appearance: none and :indeterminate on the native progress element.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback :indeterminate A `<div role="progressbar">` with its ARIA attributes kept in sync by hand. The native `<progress>` with `appearance: none`, so the role and the value stay native. appearance container-style-queries indeterminate

title: Range sliders with datalist ticks
description: A scroll-driven gradient fill and datalist tick marks for input range.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback <datalist> Vendor pseudo-elements, a fill only Firefox could draw, and tick labels that never showed. A scroll-driven animation on the thumb fills the track, and `display: flex` brings the `<datalist>` labels back. datalist input-range scroll-driven-animations

title: opui 6.0
description: What changed in 6.0 and why, with live demos.
headings: It's a proper design system now Four example themes Token tiers Contrast as a guarantee Loads of new components So much cool stuff in the docs Blocks! Theme builder The CSS is the component One Astro file, four frameworks Slots become parts, props get one naming model The platform did the work Browser support, honestly The new "by hand" Where it landed Migrating

title: A select you can style
description: appearance: base-select, ::picker(select) and :open for a fully styled select.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback base-select A rebuilt listbox: a button, a popup, ARIA roles and JavaScript for focus, keyboard and typeahead. `appearance: base-select` makes the real `<select>` stylable, with `<selectedcontent>` and `::picker(select)`. customizable-select open-pseudo

title: Spinners from aria-busy
description: aria-busy=true is all it takes to show a spinner.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback aria-busy A spinner class for sighted users and `aria-busy` for assistive technology, kept in sync. `[aria-busy="true"]` is the only switch, and a `::before` ring spins. animations-css not

title: A switch from a checkbox
description: A native checkbox, appearance: none and an outline trick.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback appearance: none A `<button>` with `aria-checked` toggled in JavaScript, or a hidden checkbox plus extra spans. `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">` with `appearance: none` draws its own track and dot. appearance light-dark

title: A header that knows it's stuck
description: scroll-state() container queries give a stuck table header and a scrolled dialog their shadows.
headings: The problem The trick Scroll shadows Try it Fallback scroll-state() A scroll listener, or an `IntersectionObserver` with a sentinel element. `container-type: scroll-state` and `@container scroll-state(stuck: block-start)` show the shadow. anchor-positioning container-scroll-state-queries

title: Tabs from radio buttons
description: Radio inputs, order and :nth-child(of S) for CSS-only tabs.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback :nth-child(of S) JavaScript for clicks, `aria-selected` and panels, or CSS tabs with one selector per tab. One radio group, and `:checked + label + panel` shows the right panel. nth-child-of

title: Validation that waits with :user-invalid
description: :user-invalid shows errors after the user interacts, not on page load.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback :user-invalid JavaScript that adds a touched class on blur. `:user-invalid` only matches after the user has changed the field and left it, or tried to submit. user-pseudos

title: Textareas that grow with field-sizing
description: field-sizing: content and lh units for auto-growing textareas.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback field-sizing JavaScript that resets the height to `scrollHeight` on every keystroke. `field-sizing: content` grows and shrinks the textarea with its text. field-sizing lh

title: Tooltips with interestfor
description: interestfor, calc-size() and @position-try for tooltips that stay on screen.
headings: The problem The trick Staying on screen Try it Fallback interestfor Event listeners, delays and a positioning library that measures and flips. `interestfor` and `popover="hint"` open it on hover and focus, and anchor positioning keeps it on screen. anchor-positioning calc-size interest-invokers popover-hint

title: Under the hood
description: Most components, built one step at a time. Pick a step and the demo runs only the CSS up to it.

title: Vertical rhythm with round()
description: round() snaps line heights and font sizes to a rhythm step.
headings: The problem The trick Try it Fallback round() A Sass function per font size, which breaks once sizes are fluid. `round(up, value, step)` snaps every line height to the grid at computed time. registered-custom-properties round-mod-rem

title: Accordion Actions API
description: Reference for Accordion Actions Solid component.
api: AccordionActions A group of actions, such as buttons. align Alignment for the actions.

title: Accordion Summary API
description: Reference for Accordion Summary Solid component.
api: AccordionSummary The always visible header. The marker. Renders a chevron by default. Only `.ui-marker` animates. marker

title: Accordion API
description: Reference for Accordion Solid component.
api: Accordion Container element. The always visible header. The marker. In Astro, React, Svelte and Vue, `AccordionSummary` renders a chevron by default. Only `.ui-marker` animates. The collapsible content. A group of actions, such as buttons. name Groups accordions so only one of them can be open at a time. markerAnimation How the marker animates when the accordion opens. `rotate` turns it upside down, `flip` mirrors it, and `turn` turns it a quarter turn, for a marker that points to the inline end and then points down when open. The default chevron points down, so `turn` needs a custom marker. open Whether the accordion is open. variant The variant to use. The default `plain` accordion has the page surface and no border, like a Card. `transparent` has no surface or border, and no inline padding.

title: Anchor API
description: Reference for Anchor Solid component.
api: Anchor Container element. Scopes the anchor to its content. The content the floating content is anchored to. The floating content. id The id of the root. With `trigger="hover"`, the id of `AnchorContent`. Add `interestfor` with the same id to the trigger. Required with `trigger="hover"`. positionArea Any valid `position-area` value. Controls where the floating content is placed. The `self-` keywords follow the content's own direction, so the placement mirrors in a right-to-left part of a left-to-right page. trigger Shows the floating content on hover and focus with `popover="hint"`. Without it, the content always shows.

title: Avatar Group API
description: Reference for Avatar Group Solid component.
api: AvatarGroup A group of overlapping avatars. aria-label The accessible name of the group. The Astro, React and Svelte types require it, or `aria-labelledby`. In Vue it passes through as an attribute. aria-labelledby The id of the element that names the group, instead of `aria-label`.

title: Avatar API
description: Reference for Avatar Solid component.
api: Avatar Container element. The avatar image. alt src alt Alternative text for the image. Required with `src`. Use an empty string when the name is shown next to it. as The element to render. Defaults to `"a"` with `href`. disabled Disables a button avatar. A link avatar drops its `href` and gets `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"` instead. href The link to use. Renders an `<a>`. shape The shape of the avatar. size The size of the element. src The image source. Replaces the content. variant The variant to use. `filled` is the primary color, `outlined` the border color with no fill and `tonal` the primary tint.

title: Badge API
description: Reference for Badge Solid component.
api: Badge Container element. The element the badge is anchored to. default The indicator, inside `.ui-floating`. Holds `label`, the visible text with `hideLabel`, or only screen reader text with `dot`. label indicator color Optional colors. corner The corner the indicator sits on. dot Renders the indicator as a dot. `label` stays as screen reader text, and the `indicator` slot isn't shown. hideLabel Hides `label` visually, for the whole sentence screen readers read, such as "5 unread messages". The `indicator` slot then holds the visible text and is hidden from screen readers. invisible Hides the indicator.

title: Button Group API
description: Reference for Button Group Solid component.
api: ButtonGroup Container element. The buttons and button links. default color Optional colors for the buttons. orientation The orientation of the element. overflow What the items do when they don't fit. `wrap` wraps them onto more rows, `scroll` keeps them on one row and scrolls it sideways, and `shrink` keeps them on one row and truncates labels with an ellipsis. Icon-only items keep their size. size The size of the buttons. variant The variant of the buttons.

title: Button API
description: Reference for Button Solid component.
api: Button Container element. An optional icon. The label next to an icon. The CSS styles the `span`, and `.ui-text` is a hook for your own styles. An optional keyboard hint. aria-label The accessible name, for a button without visible text. React and Svelte require it, or `aria-labelledby`, when there are no `children`. aria-labelledby The id of the element that names a button without visible text, instead of `aria-label`. as The element to render. Defaults to `"a"` with `href`. color Optional colors. disabled Disables the button. A link button drops its `href` and gets `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"`. href The link to use. Renders an `<a>`. round Fully rounded corners, a circle when icon-only. size The size of the element. variant The variant to use.

title: Callout API
description: Reference for Callout Solid component.
api: Callout Container element. An optional icon before the content. In Astro, React, Svelte and Vue, `CalloutIcon` renders the default one for critical, info, success and warning. The content, with an optional heading first. A row of buttons under the content. A close button, a `.ui-button` that is a direct child of the callout. It sits at the end of the first row. severity The severity. Sets the color, and in Astro, React, Svelte and Vue the icon `CalloutIcon` renders. variant The variant to use.

title: Card Actions API
description: Reference for Card Actions Solid component.
api: CardActions A group of actions, such as buttons. align Alignment for the actions.

title: Card Header API
description: Reference for Card Header Solid component.
api: CardHeader The card header. as The element to render. Use `div` for a header row with an avatar or a button next to the heading, and put the heading in an `hgroup` inside it.

title: Card API
description: Reference for Card Solid component.
api: Card Container element. An image or video that runs to the edges of the card. `img`, `picture` and `video` children fill the width and crop to the height you give them. The card header. The card content. A group of actions, such as buttons. color Paints a thick `--ui-primary` outline around the card, for the one card in a row that stands out, like a recommended plan. density How much room the parts get. `spacious` pads them with `--ui-space-5` for a card that stands alone, such as a sign-in form, `dense` with `--ui-space-2` for a small stat. orientation The orientation of the element. With `auto`, a card whose first child is an image, picture or video puts it at the start, over the full height, with the other parts next to it, once the card is `40rem` wide, and on top below that. `horizontal` always puts it at the start and `vertical` always on top. The image takes `--_media-inline-size`, `40%` of the card. variant The variant to use. The default `plain` card has the page surface color and no border.

title: Carousel API
description: Reference for Carousel Solid component.
api: Carousel The scroller. The previous button. `::scroll-button(block-start)` when vertical. buttons previousLabel An item. default The next button. `::scroll-button(block-end)` when vertical. buttons nextLabel A marker, one per item. markerLabel markers align Where items snap. aria-label The accessible name of the carousel. The Astro, React and Svelte types require it, or `aria-labelledby`. In Vue it passes through as an attribute. aria-labelledby The id of the element that names the carousel, instead of `aria-label`. aspectRatio Aspect ratio that images, videos and iframes are cropped to. buttons Previous and next buttons. `outside` places them beside the items, and `none` leaves them out. itemsPerView Number of visible items. markerLabel Accessible name of each marker, with `{count}` where the item number goes. markers One marker per item, after the list. nextLabel Accessible name of the next button. orientation The orientation of the element. A vertical carousel is `--_block-size` tall, `24rem` by default. peek Shows part of the neighboring items. persistentButtons Keeps the buttons visible at the ends. A disabled button has a muted border. previousLabel Accessible name of the previous button. stretch Makes each item a grid, so its content (a card, a link) fills the item's height. Media with an aspect ratio keeps it.

title: Checkbox Input API
description: Reference for Checkbox Input Solid component.
api: CheckboxInput The checkbox input, without a label. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` when omitted. indeterminate Shows a partially checked state. Sets the `indeterminate` property on the `<input>`.

title: Checkbox API
description: Reference for Checkbox Solid component.
api: Checkbox Container element. The checkbox input. The label. label default Supporting text displayed below the label. endText end-text card Renders the checkbox as a card: a padded, outlined surface that tints when hovered and when checked, with the label and `endText` inside. Add `spread` to put the input at the end, and `variant` to change the surface. disabled Dims the checkbox and shows a not-allowed cursor. `aria-disabled="true"` looks the same, but keeps the checkbox focusable and its value in the form, and doesn't stop the change, so block it with a script. error Marks the control invalid and shows error styles. hideLabel Visually hides the label, `.ui-sr-only` instead of `.ui-label`. id The id of the `<input>`. indeterminate Shows a partially checked state. Sets the `indeterminate` property on the `<input>`. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` applies. orientation The orientation of the element. `vertical` stacks the label under the input. required Adds a required mark after the label. The form won't submit until it's checked. size The size of the element. spread Pushes the label and the input to opposite ends. value The value of the `<input>`, submitted with the form when it's checked. variant The surface of the card, with `card`. `outlined` has a border, `tonal` a tinted surface and `elevated` a shadow, like Card.

title: Chip API
description: Reference for Chip Solid component.
api: Chip Container element. Can be a `<div>`, `<a>` or `<button>`. Optional content at the start, such as an icon. start The label, text or rich content. label label Optional content at the end, such as an icon. end as The element to render. Defaults to `"a"` with `href`. disabled Disables a button chip. A link chip drops its `href` and gets `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"` instead. dot Adds a leading dot in the chip's color. `critical`, `warning` and `neutral` shape it. href The link to use. Renders an `<a>`. multiline Lets the label wrap to multiple lines. severity The severity of a status chip. It tints the chip, and colors and shapes its dot. size The size of the element. variant The variant to use.

title: Copy API
description: Reference for Copy Solid component.
api: Copy The `<opui-copy>` custom element around the text or field to copy, with `display: contents`. The live region that announces the copy, visually hidden with `.ui-sr-only`. The label next to the button that shows `copiedLabel` or `failedLabel`. copiedLabel failedLabel copiedLabel The text shown and announced after a copy. failedLabel The text shown and announced when the clipboard is blocked. id The id the copy button points at with `commandfor`. Required.

title: Description List Item API
description: Reference for Description List Item Solid component.
api: DescriptionListItem Groups a term with its description. total Marks the item as the total of the list: a line above it, larger bold text and the strong text color, for the last row of an order summary.

title: Description List API
description: Reference for Description List Solid component.
api: DescriptionList Container element. Groups a term with its description. The term. The description. bordered Adds a line between the term and the description. dotted Makes the `bordered` line dotted. orientation The orientation of the items. `auto` stacks the term and the description when the list is `45ch` or narrower, `horizontal` keeps them side by side at any width.

title: Dialog Footer API
description: Reference for Dialog Footer Solid component.
api: DialogFooter A row at the end, for buttons, text or anything else. Groups buttons. Moves to the end when other content comes first. align Alignment for the footer content.

title: Dialog Header API
description: Reference for Dialog Header Solid component.
api: DialogHeader Container element. Closes the dialog. Renders a close icon by default, or the `svg` in `close-icon`. closeLabel close-icon closeLabel The accessible name of the close button. Set it to add a close button at the end of the title row, which closes its `Dialog` through the dialog's `id`.

title: Dialog API
description: Reference for Dialog Solid component.
api: Dialog Container element. The header, a row for the title and anything next to it, with an optional close button. The title. Names the dialog through `aria-labelledby`. The scrollable content. The footer, a row at the end. closedby How the dialog can be closed. `"any"` also closes it on a click outside.

title: Divider API
description: Reference for Divider Solid component.
api:
Divider The divider line. An `
`, or a `
` or `

` with content in the middle. align Where the content sits on the line. color Optional colors. variant The variant to use.

title: Drawer Footer API
description: Reference for Drawer Footer Solid component.
api: DrawerFooter A row at the end, for buttons, text or anything else. Groups buttons. Moves to the end when other content comes first. align Alignment for the footer content.

title: Drawer Header API
description: Reference for Drawer Header Solid component.
api: DrawerHeader Container element. Closes the drawer. Renders a close icon by default, or the `svg` in `close-icon`. closeLabel close-icon closeLabel The accessible name of the close button. commandfor The id of the drawer to close with the `close` command. Without it, the button closes its `Drawer`. Outside a `Drawer`, set it to the id of the `<dialog>` to close, or a dev warning says it is missing.

title: Drawer API
description: Reference for Drawer Solid component.
api: Drawer Container element. The header, a row for the title and anything next to it, with a close button. The title. Names the drawer through `aria-labelledby`. The scrollable content. The footer, a row at the end. backdrop The backdrop style. `"transparent"` keeps the page behind it fully visible. closedby How the drawer can be closed. `"any"` also closes it on a click outside. id The id of the `<dialog>`, which the trigger's `commandfor` points at. Required. scrollLock Locks page scroll while the drawer is open. With a transparent backdrop the page stays scrollable, except on screens narrower than 500px. side The side it opens from.

title: Field Description API
description: Reference for Field Description Solid component.
api: FieldDescription Supporting text for a fieldset.

title: Field Group API
description: Reference for Field Group Solid component.
api: FieldGroup Container element. name Sets `name` on the OPUI fields inside that don't set their own. orientation The orientation of the fields. With `auto`, fields stack and a group with only buttons lines up in a row.

title: Field Legend API
description: Reference for Field Legend Solid component.
api: FieldLegend The label of a fieldset. as The element to render. Adds `.ui-legend` when not `"legend"`.

title: Fieldset API
description: Reference for Fieldset Solid component.
api: Fieldset Container element. The label of the fieldset. Supporting text displayed below the legend. Supporting or error text for the whole group, after the fields. as The element to render. Elements other than `fieldset` get `role="group"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the `FieldLegend`, unless `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is passed. disabled Disables every field inside. Only on a `<fieldset>`.

title: Form API
description: Reference for Form Solid component.
api: Form Container element. Spaces its fieldsets and fields. as The element to render.

title: Layout API
description: Reference for Layout Solid component.
api: Layout Any element. The classes only set its layout. align Where `.ui-layout-row` puts its children along the row, and where `.ui-layout-column` lines up its children and their text. breakpoint The container width at which `.ui-layout-columns` goes from one column to `--_columns`: `40rem`, `56rem` or `72rem`. column A column with even space between its children. columns One column that becomes the `--_columns` tracks at the breakpoint, measured on the nearest container, such as `.ui-layout-container`. container Centers its content, caps its width and is the container `.ui-layout-columns` measures. grid Columns that fill the width and wrap. On a `ul` or `ol` it also drops the list bullets and margins, and a `.ui-card` in each `li` fills its cell. media A media object: a fixed-size start, such as an avatar, next to text that fills the rest and wraps instead of widening the row. row A wrapping row with its children centered on one line. On a `ul` or `ol` it also drops the list bullets and margins. size The space between children of `.ui-layout-column`, `.ui-layout-row`, `.ui-layout-grid`, `.ui-layout-columns` and `.ui-layout-media`. spread Pushes the children of `.ui-layout-row` to its two ends, for a page header with a heading group and its actions. sticky On a child of `.ui-layout-columns`, keeps it in view at `--_sticky-inset` from the top while the other column scrolls, once the columns sit side by side. stretch Stretches the columns of `.ui-layout-grid` over the row when there are fewer children than fit, instead of leaving the rest empty.

title: List Item API
description: Reference for List Item Solid component.
api: ListItem The list item. The clickable row, rendered by `as`, `href` or `type`. as href type Optional content at the start, such as an icon or avatar. start The text content. The label, the first paragraph. label label Supporting text, the second paragraph. description description Optional content at the end, such as a value or an action. end as The element to render inside the `<li>`: `"a"` or `"button"`. Defaults to `"a"` when `href` is set, and to nothing otherwise, so a static item is a bare `<li>`. A `<button>` gets `type="button"`. borderTop Adds a border above the item. color Optional colors. `critical` marks a destructive item in a [Menu](/components/menu). disabled Disables a button item. A link item drops its `href` and gets `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"` instead. for The `for` attribute of the `<label>` when `type` is set. href The link to use. Renders an `<a>` inside the `<li>`. inset Aligns the text with items that have start content. type Wraps the content in a `<label>` for a checkbox, radio or switch. Can't be combined with `as` or `href`.

title: List API
description: Reference for List Solid component.
api: List Container element. A list item. bordered Adds a border between list items. dense Packs the items tighter. flush Removes the inline padding of the items and the block padding of the list. variant The variant to use. The default `filled` list uses the filled surface.

title: Menu API
description: Reference for Menu Solid component.
api: Menu The menu surface, a popover anchored to its trigger. A group heading. HTML and CSS only. An item, holding a `<button>` or an `<a>` with `href`. Rendered from `items`, or a `ListItem` in the default slot. Optional content at the start, such as an icon. The label (`label` on an item). Optional content at the end, such as a shortcut in a `<kbd>` (`shortcut` on an item). align Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with. bordered Adds a border between the items. dense Packs the items tighter. id The id of the menu, which the trigger's `commandfor` points at. Required. items The items, as `{ borderTop, color, disabled, href, keepOpen, label, shortcut }` objects. `borderTop` adds a border above the item, `color: "critical"` marks a destructive one, a disabled link has no `href`, and `keepOpen` keeps the menu open on click. Other keys go to the item's `<a>` or `<button>`. popover The popover type. With `"manual"`, Esc and a click outside don't close the menu, and opening another menu doesn't either. side The side of the trigger the menu opens on.

title: Message API
description: Reference for Message Solid component.
api: Message A message. The sender's `Avatar`, from the `start` slot, shown on the last message of a run. start The bubble. default The sender's name. author The time, and content such as a read receipt. datetime time Content after the time, such as a read receipt. end Reactions in a `ToggleGroup`, drawn as separate pills over the bottom edge of the bubble. bottom author The sender, shown on the first message of a run and read by screen readers on every message. datetime The machine-readable date and time of `time`. newAuthor Starts a new run when the author changes, for a group chat. outgoing A message you sent. It aligns to the end in the primary color, and its author is visually hidden. time The time as shown, at the end of the bubble. typing Shows animated dots instead of the content. The default slot becomes the status text for screen readers.

title: Messages API
description: Reference for Messages Solid component.
api: Messages The conversation, an ordered list. A message. Consecutive messages on the same side group into a run.

title: Number Field API
description: Reference for Number Field Solid component.
api: NumberField The `<opui-number-field>` custom element. It steps the value and marks a button `aria-disabled` at `min` or `max`. The label for the field. label label Start text displayed above the field. startText start-text The boxed input area. The decrease button, with `command="--step-down"`. Renders a minus icon by default, or the `svg` in `decrease-icon`. Hidden until the element is defined. decreaseLabel decrease-icon The input element. The increase button, with `command="--step-up"`. Renders a plus icon by default, or the `svg` in `increase-icon`. Hidden until the element is defined. increaseLabel increase-icon Supporting text displayed below the field. endText end-text decreaseLabel The accessible name of the decrease button. disabled Dims the field and blocks input and the step buttons. error Marks the control invalid and shows error styles. hideLabel Visually hides the label, `.ui-sr-only` instead of `.ui-label`. The field keeps it as its accessible name. id The id of the `<input>`. The label and the step buttons point at it, so the component generates one when it's left out. The start and end text ids start with it: `x-start-text` and `x-end-text` for `id="x"`. increaseLabel The accessible name of the increase button. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` applies. required Adds a required mark after the label. The form won't submit while the field is empty. size The size of the element. spread Pushes the label and start text to one side and the field to the other. stretch Fills the available width. Without it, the field fits its value, from `--_min-inline-size` (`4ch`). variant The variant to use.

title: One Time Code API
description: Reference for One Time Code Solid component.
api: OneTimeCode Container element. The label for the field. label label Draws a box per character and a ring on the next one. The input element. Supporting text displayed below the field. endText end-text alphanumeric Accepts letters and digits. Letters show uppercase and keep the case they were typed in. autocapitalize The `autocapitalize` of the `<input>`. With `alphanumeric` it is `characters`. autocomplete The `autocomplete` of the `<input>`. `one-time-code` lets the browser fill in a code it received. disabled Dims the field and blocks input. error Marks the control invalid and shows error styles. grouped Draws a dash between the two halves of the code. id The id of the `<input>`. inputmode The `inputmode` of the `<input>`. Without `alphanumeric` it is `numeric`. length The number of characters and boxes, from 4 to 8. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` applies. pattern The `pattern` of the `<input>`. It is `[0-9]{length}`, or `[A-Za-z0-9]{length}` with `alphanumeric`. required Adds a required mark after the label. The form won't submit while the code is incomplete. size The size of the element. spellcheck The `spellcheck` of the `<input>`. With `alphanumeric` it is `false`.

title: Progress API
description: Reference for Progress Solid component.
api: Progress Container element. The progress bar. max value max The maximum value. round Draws the progress as a ring, `--ui-icon-size-large` wide, for a small space such as a button or a list item. Needs typed `attr()`; other browsers show the bar. value The current value. Omit it for an indeterminate state. variant The variant to use.

title: Radio Input API
description: Reference for Radio Input Solid component.
api: RadioInput The radio input, without a label. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` when omitted.

title: Radio API
description: Reference for Radio Solid component.
api: Radio Container element. The radio input. The label. label default Supporting text displayed below the label. endText end-text card Renders the radio as a card: a padded, outlined surface that tints when hovered and when checked, with the label and `endText` inside. Add `spread` to put the input at the end, and `variant` to change the surface. disabled Dims the radio and shows a not-allowed cursor. `aria-disabled="true"` looks the same, but keeps the radio focusable and its value in the form, and doesn't stop the change, so block it with a script. error Marks the control invalid and shows error styles. hideLabel Visually hides the label, `.ui-sr-only` instead of `.ui-label`. id The id of the `<input>`. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` applies. orientation The orientation of the element. `vertical` stacks the label under the input. required Adds a required mark after the label. The form won't submit until one radio in the group is checked. size The size of the element. spread Pushes the label and the input to opposite ends. value The value of the `<input>`, submitted with the form when it's checked. variant The surface of the card, with `card`. `outlined` has a border, `tonal` a tinted surface and `elevated` a shadow, like Card.

title: Range API
description: Reference for Range Solid component.
api: Range Container element. The label for the range. label label Shows the current value, with an optional `valueSuffix`. `opui-css/css/js/range.js` keeps it in step with the thumb, and content in the `value-text` slot replaces it. valueSuffix value-text Description text displayed above the input. startText start-text The range input. Tick marks and their labels, under the input. items list datalist Supporting text displayed below the input. endText end-text disabled Dims the slider and blocks input. error Marks the control invalid and shows error styles. hideLabel Visually hides the label, `.ui-sr-only` instead of `.ui-label`. The field keeps it as its accessible name. id The id of the `<input>`. Generated when omitted and the value is shown. The ids the component generates start with it: `x-label`, `x-start-text`, `x-end-text` and `x-list` for `id="x"`. items Tick marks, rendered as `<option>` elements in a `<datalist>`. Each is a value, or a `{ label, value }` object for a labeled tick. Without `valueSuffix`, the label of the tick at the value is the input's `aria-valuetext`. list The id of the `<datalist>`. Generated when `items` or the `datalist` slot is used. max The largest value of the `<input>`. min The smallest value of the `<input>`. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` applies. size The size of the element. spread Pushes the label and start text to one side and the input to the other. step The step between values of the `<input>`. Without a `value`, the slider starts at the step nearest the middle. value The current value. valueSuffix Text after the shown value, such as `%`. Setting it shows the current value in an `<output>`. variant The variant to use. The default `outlined` track uses `--ui-track-bg-color`, or the field border color when the theme doesn't set it.

title: Rating API
description: Reference for Rating Solid component.
api: Rating A `<meter>` for a read-only score, or a `<fieldset>` of radios for input. The label of the input. label Clears the rating. Drawn as a muted icon, left out with `required`. clearLabel A star, one per value from `1` to `max`. starLabel The checked and total count, such as `3/5`. Hidden from screen readers. clearLabel The accessible name of the radio that clears the rating. Not rendered with `required`. disabled Disables the input. error Marks the radios invalid and tints the empty stars. label The `<legend>` of the input, or the `aria-label` of the meter. Include the score in a meter label. max Number of stars. name Renders the input: a `<fieldset>` of radios with this name. Without it, a read-only `<meter>`. required Requires a star and drops the clear radio. size The size of the element. starLabel Returns the accessible name of each star radio. Use it to translate.

title: Select All API
description: Reference for Select All Solid component.
api: SelectAll The `<opui-select-all>` custom element, `display: contents`, around the group, such as a `Fieldset` or a `Table`. The checkbox that checks and unchecks the other enabled checkboxes inside. It's checked when they all are, and `indeterminate` when some are.

title: Select API
description: Reference for Select Solid component.
api: Select Container element. The label for the field. label label Start text displayed above the field. startText start-text The boxed select area. Content above the select, inside the border, with a divider. top Content at the inline-start of the field, inside the border. start The select. Its options are in a popover list. Content at the inline-end of the field, inside the border. end Content below the select, inside the border, with a divider. bottom Supporting text displayed below the field. endText end-text autoFit Lets the width follow the selected option, from `25ch`. dense Packs the items tighter. disabled Dims the select and blocks input. error Marks the control invalid and shows error styles. hideLabel Visually hides the label, `.ui-sr-only` instead of `.ui-label`. The field keeps it as its accessible name. id The id of the `<select>`. The ids the component generates start with it: `x-label`, `x-start-text`, `x-end-text`, `x-top` and `x-bottom` for `id="x"`. items The options, as `{ label, selected, value }` objects. `value` selects among them; child `<option>` elements set `selected` themselves. name The name of the `<select>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` applies. required Adds a required mark after the label. The form won't submit until an option with a value is selected. size The size of the element. spread Pushes the label and start text to one side and the select to the other. variant The variant to use.

title: Sortable Table API
description: Reference for Sortable Table Solid component.
api: SortableTable The `<opui-sortable-table>` custom element, `display: contents`, around the table. It fires a cancelable `sort` event, moves the body rows and announces the new order. The button around a sortable header's label. A press sorts by its column, ascending first, and sets `aria-sort` on the header. ascendingLabel What a sort in ascending order announces, with `{column}` where the header's label goes. descendingLabel What a sort in descending order announces, with `{column}` where the header's label goes. onSort Called before the rows are sorted, with the column index, the direction and the header in `event.detail`. `preventDefault()` keeps the rows where they are.

title: Spinner API
description: Reference for Spinner Solid component.
api: Spinner Renders a spinner pseudo-element on the element. Always indeterminate. size Spinner size follows the element's computed font size.

title: Stat API
description: Reference for Stat Solid component.
api: Stat A `dl` with the label, the value and the description, so a screen reader reads them as one term with its details. The label. label label The value, in tabular numbers. default The description. description description description Text under the value, such as the change since last week. Rich content, such as a severity colored change, goes in the `description` slot. label What the value counts, such as Visitors. Rich content goes in the `label` slot. size The size of the value.

title: Stepper Item API
description: Reference for Stepper Item Solid component.
api: StepperItem A step. Replaces the check in the marker of a complete step. Hidden from screen readers. icon-checked The label, as a link back to the step. href label label A short line under the label. description description complete Marks the step complete: a check in the marker and the line to the next step in the accent color. completedLabel Screen reader text after the label of a complete step. current Marks the current step. Without `.ui-complete` on any step, the steps before it show as complete. description A short line under the label. error Marks a step with an error: an exclamation mark in the marker and the label in the invalid color. Wins over `complete`. errorLabel Screen reader text after the label of a step with an error. href Renders the label as a link on a complete step or a step with an error, but not on the current one. label The name of the step.

title: Stepper API
description: Reference for Stepper Solid component.
api: Stepper The list of steps. A step, with its marker and the line to the next one. current items aria-label Accessible name of the stepper. complete Marks every step in `items` complete. completedLabel Screen reader text after the label of a complete step in `items`. current The index of the current step in `items`, from 0. The steps before it are complete. errorLabel Screen reader text after the label of a step with an error in `items`. items The steps, as `{ complete, completedLabel, current, description, error, errorLabel, href, label }` objects. orientation The orientation of the element. `auto` stacks the steps below `32rem`. size The size of the element.

title: Switch Input API
description: Reference for Switch Input Solid component.
api: SwitchInput The switch input, without a label. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` when omitted.

title: Switch API
description: Reference for Switch Solid component.
api: Switch Container element. The switch input. An optional icon on the track, shown while unchecked. icon-unchecked An optional icon on the track, shown while checked. icon-checked The label. label default Supporting text displayed below the label. endText end-text card Renders the switch as a card: a padded, outlined surface that tints when hovered and when checked, with the label and `endText` inside. Add `spread` to put the input at the end, and `variant` to change the surface. disabled Dims the switch and shows a not-allowed cursor. `aria-disabled="true"` looks the same, but keeps the switch focusable and its value in the form, and doesn't stop the change, so block it with a script. error Marks the control invalid and shows error styles. hideLabel Visually hides the label, `.ui-sr-only` instead of `.ui-label`. id The id of the `<input>`. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` applies. orientation The orientation of the element. `vertical` stacks the label under the switch. required Adds a required mark after the label. The form won't submit until it's on. size The size of the element. spread Pushes the label and the switch to opposite ends. value The value of the `<input>`, submitted with the form when it's checked. variant The surface of the card, with `card`. `outlined` has a border, `tonal` a tinted surface and `elevated` a shadow, like Card.

title: Table Cell API
description: Reference for Table Cell Solid component.
api: TableCell A data cell, inside `TableRow`. numeric Aligns the cell to the end and uses tabular figures, so the digits of a column line up.

title: Table Column Group API
description: Reference for Table Column Group Solid component.
api: TableColumnGroup A group of columns, before the table head.

title: Table Column API
description: Reference for Table Column Solid component.
api: TableColumn A column, inside `TableColumnGroup`. width The column width, merged into `style`.

title: Table Header Cell API
description: Reference for Table Header Cell Solid component.
api: TableHeaderCell A header cell, inside `TableRow`. numeric Aligns the header to the end, over a column of `numeric` cells. sortable Wraps the label in a `<button>` that sorts the table by this column, inside a `SortableTable`.

title: Table API
description: Reference for Table Solid component.
api: Table Container element. The header rows. A header cell. The body rows. A row. A data cell. Optional footer rows, such as totals. An optional title for the table. density The cell padding. flush Drops the block margin, for a table that sits in a card or another padded box. overflow What the table does when its columns don't fit. `"wrap"` lets the cells wrap their text, and `"scroll"` keeps each cell on one line, scrolls the table sideways and lets the last column take the space left over. Give a scrolling table `tabindex="0"`, so keyboard users can scroll it. stickyHeader Keeps the header rows at the top of the nearest scroll container. Offset it with `--_sticky-offset`.

title: Tabs Item API
description: Reference for Tabs Item Solid component.
api: TabsItem The radio input for a tab, followed by the tab and the panel. checked Selects the tab. id The id of the input. Generated when omitted. name Overrides the name shared by the tab inputs. value The value of the input. The tab is selected while it matches the `value` of `Tabs`.

title: Tabs Label API
description: Reference for Tabs Label Solid component.
api: TabsLabel The tab. for The id of the input it labels. Set by the item.

title: Tabs Panel API
description: Reference for Tabs Panel Solid component.
api: TabsPanel The panel.

title: Tabs API
description: Reference for Tabs Solid component.
api: Tabs Container element. A visually hidden radio input that holds a tab's state. The tab is its label. A tab. The panel of the selected tab. name The name shared by the tab inputs. Generated when omitted. onValueChange Called with the `value` of the tab when one is selected. overflow What the tabs do when they don't fit. `"wrap"` wraps them onto more rows, and `"scroll"` keeps them on one row and scrolls it sideways. variant The variant to use. The default `tonal` tabs sit on a tonal track and the selected tab is a raised pill. value The `value` of the selected tab. The item whose `value` matches is checked, and the items' own `checked` is ignored.

title: Text Field API
description: Reference for Text Field Solid component.
api: TextField Container element, a `<label>`, or the `<opui-text-field>` custom element with `passwordToggle`. The label for the field. label label Start text displayed above the field. startText start-text The boxed input area. Content above the input, inside the border, with a divider. top Content at the inline-start of the field, inside the border. start The input element. Content at the inline-end of the field, inside the border, and the password toggle. end The password toggle, with `aria-pressed` and `command="--toggle-password"`. Renders an eye in `.ui-icon-unchecked` and a crossed-out eye in `.ui-icon-checked` by default, or the icons in `icon-unchecked` and `icon-checked`, and shows one of them. Hidden until `<opui-text-field>` is defined. passwordToggle passwordToggleLabel icon-checked icon-unchecked Content below the input, inside the border, with a divider. bottom Supporting text displayed below the field. endText end-text The character count, `aria-hidden` so it stays out of the field's name. Near the limit, a live region outside the label announces the characters left. characterCount characterCountLabel autoFit Lets the width follow the content, from `25ch`. characterCount Shows the characters typed out of `maxlength` in the end text, and announces how many are left once 10% or 10 are left, whichever is more. The component loads `opui-css/elements/character-count.js`, which keeps the count. characterCountLabel The announcement near the limit, with `{count}` for the characters left. Pass it translated. dropZone Makes a `type="file"` field a tall drop zone with a dashed border. The whole input takes files dropped on it, and a click opens the file picker. disabled Dims the field and blocks input. `aria-disabled="true"` looks the same, but keeps the field focusable, its text editable and its value in the form. error Marks the control invalid and shows error styles. hideLabel Visually hides the label, `.ui-sr-only` instead of `.ui-label`. The field keeps it as its accessible name. id The id of the `<input>`. With `passwordToggle`, the label and the toggle point at it, so the component generates one when it's left out, and the start and end text ids start with it: `x-start-text` and `x-end-text` for `id="x"`. inputmode The `inputmode` of the `<input>`. With `type="numeric"` it is `numeric`. name The name of the `<input>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` applies. passwordToggle Adds a button to the end of a `type="password"` field that shows and hides the password. The root becomes `<opui-text-field>` with a `<label for>`, since a button inside a `<label>` would join the field's name, and the start and end text describe the input. The component loads `opui-css/elements/text-field.js`, which runs the button. passwordToggleLabel The accessible name of the password toggle. pattern The `pattern` of the `<input>`. With `type="numeric"` it is `[0-9]*`. required Adds a required mark after the label. The form won't submit while the field is empty. size The size of the element. spread Pushes the label and start text to one side and the input to the other. type The input type. `"numeric"` renders a text input with a numeric keyboard. variant The variant to use.

title: Textarea API
description: Reference for Textarea Solid component.
api: Textarea Container element. The label for the field. label label Start text displayed above the field. startText start-text The boxed textarea area. Content above the textarea, inside the border, with a divider. top Content at the inline-start of the field, inside the border. start The textarea element. Content at the inline-end of the field, inside the border. end Content below the textarea, inside the border, with a divider. bottom Supporting text displayed below the field. endText end-text The character count, `aria-hidden` so it stays out of the field's name. Near the limit, a live region outside the label announces the characters left. characterCount characterCountLabel autoFit Lets the width follow the content and allows resizing in both directions. characterCount Shows the characters typed out of `maxlength` in the end text, and announces how many are left once 10% or 10 are left, whichever is more. The component loads `opui-css/elements/character-count.js`, which keeps the count. characterCountLabel The announcement near the limit, with `{count}` for the characters left. Pass it translated. disabled Dims the field and blocks input. `aria-disabled="true"` looks the same, but keeps the field focusable, its text editable and its value in the form. error Marks the control invalid and shows error styles. hideLabel Visually hides the label, `.ui-sr-only` instead of `.ui-label`. The field keeps it as its accessible name. id The id of the `<textarea>`. name The name of the `<textarea>`. Inside a `FieldGroup`, the group's `name` applies. required Adds a required mark after the label. The form won't submit while the field is empty. size The size of the element. spread Pushes the label and start text to one side and the textarea to the other. variant The variant to use.

title: Timeline Item API
description: Reference for Timeline Item Solid component.
api: TimelineItem An event. The date, in its own column. datetime time Replaces the dot with an icon. It follows the item's color and the current state. marker The title of the event. headingLevel label label color Optional colors. current Marks the current item, which fills its marker with the primary color and a halo. `true` renders `aria-current="true"`, and `"step"`, `"date"` or `"time"` that value. datetime The machine-readable date of `time`. headingLevel The heading level of `label`, so the item fits the page outline. label The title of the event, rendered as a heading. Rich content goes in the `label` slot. time The date as shown, in the date column.

title: Timeline API
description: Reference for Timeline Solid component.
api: Timeline Container element. An event, with its marker and the line to the next one. items The items, as `{ color, current, datetime, description, headingLevel, label, time }` objects. `description` renders a paragraph. size The size of the element. tracked Colors the line and the plain markers before the current item with the primary color, like a progress tracker.

title: Toast API
description: Reference for Toast Solid component.
api: Toaster The `<opui-toaster>` custom element, with `display: contents`. A button with `commandfor` and `command="--toast"` shows a toast with its `data-toast` text and `data-toast-severity`, and `toast(message, { action, duration, severity })` or `toast.success(message)` does it from a script, where `action` takes a `label` and an `onClick`. `dismiss(toast)` returns a promise that resolves once the toast is gone. The stack of toasts, a manual popover at the block end and the inline end of the viewport unless `side` and `align` move it. It opens with the first toast and closes after the last. A toast, a `Callout` with the severity class, its icon (an empty `svg` that `--_icon-image` masks), the message in `.ui-content`, an action `Button` when it has an `action`, and a close `Button`. The element adds it, and on dismiss makes it `inert`, fades it out and closes its gap before it removes it. The polite live region that announces each toast but a critical one, visually hidden with `.ui-sr-only` and outside the popover, so it's always in the page. The assertive live region that announces a critical toast at once, visually hidden like the status region. Without it, critical toasts go to the status region. align Where the toasts sit along their side of the viewport. closeLabel The accessible name of the close button of each toast. duration How long a toast stays, in milliseconds, while the pointer and focus are elsewhere. id The id the buttons point at with `commandfor`. Required. side The side of the viewport the toasts sit on.

title: Toggle Button API
description: Reference for Toggle Button Solid component.
api: ToggleButton Container element. A visually hidden checkbox or radio input. checked Selects the button. disabled Dims the button and skips it with Tab and the arrow keys. `aria-disabled="true"` looks the same, but keeps the button focusable and its value in the form, and doesn't stop the change, so block it with a script. id The id of the `<input>`. label The button text when there is no child content. name The name of the input. Falls back to the `ToggleGroup`'s name, then to a `FieldGroup`'s. required The form won't submit until it's checked. A `ToggleGroup` without `multiple` needs it on one button only. size The size of the element. type The input type. `"radio"` allows one selection in a group. A `ToggleGroup` without `multiple` makes every button a radio. value The value of the input.

title: Toggle Group API
description: Reference for Toggle Group Solid component.
api: ToggleGroup Container element. A toggle button. multiple Lets several buttons be checked, with checkbox inputs. Without it, one button is checked at a time, with radio inputs in a `[role="radiogroup"]`. name The name shared by the inputs. Generated when omitted. onValueChange Called with the new selection when a button is toggled. orientation The orientation of the element. overflow What the items do when they don't fit. `wrap` wraps them onto more rows, `scroll` keeps them on one row and scrolls it sideways, and `shrink` keeps them on one row and truncates labels with an ellipsis. Icon-only items keep their size. size The size of the buttons. value The value of the checked button, or the values of the checked buttons with `multiple`. The buttons whose `value` matches are checked, and their own `checked` is ignored.

title: Tooltip API
description: Reference for Tooltip Solid component.
api: Tooltip Container element. The trigger that shows the tooltip on hover and focus. The tooltip, a `popover="hint"`. arrow Adds an arrow that points to the trigger. id The id of the tooltip. Add `interestfor` with the same id to the trigger, and on a toggletip `commandfor` and `command="toggle-popover"` too. Required. positionArea Any valid `position-area` value. Controls where the tooltip is placed. The `self-` keywords follow the tooltip's own direction, so the placement mirrors in a right-to-left part of a left-to-right page.

title: Typography API
description: Reference for Typography Solid component.
api: Typography Classless typography for uncontrolled child markup. blockquote Quoted block with a start border. caption Muted supporting text. codeBlock Monospace preformatted block. color Tone of `.ui-swatch`, and the text color of `.ui-p`, `.ui-caption` and `.ui-overline`. Without it, the swatch takes the palette accent of the scope it sits in. heading Heading styles for any element. headingGroup Groups an overline, heading, and optional body copy. icon Sizes an inline `svg` to `--ui-icon-size` and keeps it from shrinking in a flex row. inline Inline text element utilities. link Link styles outside `.ui-rich-text`. On hover and focus, the underline gets thicker. The color gets darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode. notRichText Ends the `.ui-rich-text` styles inside it. overline Small uppercase label text. paragraph Body paragraph styling. size Size modifiers on `.ui-p` and `.ui-icon`. An icon reads `--ui-icon-size-small` and `--ui-icon-size-large`. tabularNums Digits of one width, so numbers line up in a column of prices or stats. swatch A small colored dot for a legend, in `--_swatch-bg-color`, the palette accent of its tone or scope.
